name: FUN_SEQ_ASSIGNMENTS_
description: This table contains the assignments of a sequence definition.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Sequence assignment identifier.

columns.name: SEQ_CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Sequence assignment context identifier.

columns.name: SEQ_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Sequence definition identifier.

columns.name: LINK_TO_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Parent sequence assignment identifier.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: CONTROL_ATTRIBUTE_STRUCTURE
columns.description: Represents sequence application and event type.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE
columns.description: Balance type of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: JOURNAL_SOURCE
columns.description: Journal source of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: JOURNAL_CATEGORY
columns.description: Journal category of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting event type of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting entry type of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Document category of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the sequence assignment.

columns.name: USE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for the sequence assignment.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
